name: Realm Bank: a soulbound item cannot be deposited, and the deposit never removes it
contract: #7468: the Realm Bank is shared by the whole account (owner key is the account id, mod_ascension_bank_item.owner_kind=1), so it has no single character to own a soulbound item. StoreSlot (AscensionPersonalBank.cpp) wrote SetOwnerGUID(Empty) for every Realm Bank deposit, so a soulbound item deposited there could never pass Item::IsBindedNotWith on withdraw (owner Empty != withdrawing player) and answered EQUIP_ERR_DONT_OWN_THAT_ITEM, stranding the item (item_instance.owner_guid stays 0 forever). DepositToBank now refuses a soulbound deposit into a Realm Bank up front with EQUIP_ERR_CANT_DROP_SOULBOUND, the same rule and error code Guild::BankMoveItemData::CanStore already uses for the guild bank (Guild.cpp:1007-1008): the item stays in the depositor's bags instead of being accepted and later stranded. A non-soulbound item is unaffected and still deposits and withdraws normally.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
The Realm Bank's spell follows its item
Let the vault summon land in the world
SETUP: the item is soulbound as soon as it is acquired
SETUP: the control item is not soulbound
Try to deposit the soulbound item
The refused deposit leaves the soulbound item in the bags
The control item leaves the bags
The control item returns to the bags, in full
